claims.assertion: Mari Swa reports that a hurricane damaged more than 100 buildings in Toleka and destroyed 54 homes, with deaths and injuries across Temmer.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: These figures are reported in her account, which says the storm appeared natural.

claims.assertion: Mari says Toleka’s forest-integrated design left fallen trees and plants blocking roads and emergency hangar doors during the storm.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says this delayed rescue response.

claims.assertion: Mari says she ordered weather-control systems activated to divert developing storms after the hurricane.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says some residents criticized the intervention.

review_flags: The source is an unverified first-person account framed as entertainment.
coverage_gaps: The account also describes reconstruction, ecological tradeoffs, and remote immersion technology.
